#3561: the canonical publish path now appends an event before it changes anything observable. The session row and a provider-started turn's boundary row are written inside the event's append savepoint (appendEvent coCommit). The read model, turn progress, child work, client-origin, approval-posture and confinement clears, and the cooperative stop settle run after commit. A contention retry restamps lifecycle from current state. A work-item settlement failure after RELEASE no longer reports a committed append as failed. Server-internal ordering: no API, wire, route, config, env, metric-name or UI change. Checked this document's claims that cite src-server/services/orchestration/orchestration-service.ts; none describe the pre-append ordering, so it stays accurate.
